# Grid Patch Shikaku Logic Puzzle — Find the perfect solution

Grid Patch turns numbers into satisfying logic challenges. Draw a rectangle around each card (called clue) and make it cover exactly the required number of cells.

**The rules are simple. Finding the answer is where the challenge begins.**
